parameters.query:
UPDATE tickets
SET category = '{{ $json.category }}',
    priority = '{{ $json.priority }}',
    sentiment = '{{ $json.sentiment }}',
    ai_summary = '{{ $json.ai_summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    ai_draft_reply = '{{ $json.ai_draft_reply.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    status = 'CLASSIFIED',
    sla_due_at = NOW() + ({{ $json.sla_hours }} || ' hours')::interval,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE ticket_id = {{ $json.ticket_id }}
RETURNING ticket_id, ticket_ref, category, priority;

INSERT INTO ticket_events (ticket_id, event_type, workflow_name, details)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.ticket_id }},
  'CLASSIFIED',
  'WF2_AI_Classification',
  '{{ JSON.stringify({ category: $json.category, priority: $json.priority }) }}'::jsonb
);

INSERT INTO ticket_events (ticket_id, event_type, workflow_name, details)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.ticket_id }},
  'ERROR',
  'WF2_AI_Classification',
  '{{ JSON.stringify({ error: "classification update failed" }) }}'::jsonb
);
